ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.6:0.4 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zones located in the central 65% of each lobe; left lobe displays higher density of stochastic black speckling; broad black border ranging from 15-40 pixels in width follows the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central indentation with an internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of 0.12 relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire superior boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes vary from 5 to 18 pixels with denser clustering on the medial edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic sweep on the superior margins terminating in sharply defined, upward-tilting distal apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast textured clusters (brown/white nodes) localized exclusively on the distal tips of the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive focal clusters of raised calcified nodes (barnacle colonization) on the outer-most lateral edges of both fluke lobes.
